title: chamomilla inodora
intro: Chamomilla inodora, commonly known as Pineapple Weed, is a flowering plant in the daisy family that is native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health issues, including anxiety, insomnia, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits of anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Pineapple Weed include its ability to relax muscles, reduce inflammation, and act as a sedative, making it a popular natural remedy for stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Pineapple Weed include flavonoids, terpenoids, and essential oils, such as chamazulene and bisabolol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
